scientific_integrity: The proof reconstructs the \(p\)-adic valuation descent directly from the Leibniz rule, proves strict growth for \(e>p\), derives \(D(n)\le n\log_2(n)/2\), and leaves only two explicitly bounded finite fourth-iterate ranges for exact replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only prime-power solutions of the third and fourth iterate equations. It does not classify arbitrary \(D^3(n)=n\) or \(D^4(n)=n\) solutions and does not settle the general periodic-point conjecture.
title: Prime-power rigidity for the third and fourth arithmetic-derivative iterates
